name: Saya Mizoguchi
source: Rabbit high school senior and childhood friend of Yuuichi and Shoichi. She is captain of the school's tennis team and the best female tennis player not only on the team, but in the entire prefecture. After they graduate, she and Yuuichi dream of traveling to America together and taking the professional tennis scene by storm.
